studies.Title: Adherence to Mediterranean diet and prostate cancer risk in Sicily: population-based case-control study.
studies.Reference: Adherence to Mediterranean diet and prostate cancer risk in Sicily: population-based case-control study.
studies.Population: Italian men with prostate cancer and population-based controls
studies.comparison_type: Olive oil consumption in prostate cancer cases versus population-based controls

extraction_supporting_text.cases: A population-based case-control study has been conducted from January 2015 to December 2016 in a single institution of the municipality of Catania, southern Italy. A total of 118 PCa and 238 population-based controls were collected.
extraction_supporting_text.comparison: no statistically significant differences between cases and controls were found regarding fruit, legumes, and olive oil consumption
